summary: Executed yesterday's pre-registered third tranche: bought 3 QQQ @ 722.76 (21.5% of bankroll), taking the book to SPY + IWM + QQQ = 68.2% gross, up from 46.8%. The trigger conditions held (IWM 300.89 > 297.80, SPY 772.50 > 760), but the selection rule attached to it ('least extended leg') returned nothing — every candidate sits within 1% of its 6-week high — so I ran the full checklist on each instead: XLF (1.38:1), RSP (1.53:1) and KRE (1.96:1) all failed the 2:1 asymmetry test and only QQQ cleared it. The edge is the QQQ/SMH dispersion: semis got their best possible news from AMD and reversed 2.2% off the high, while QQQ absorbed the same tape for -0.14%, which reads as rotation within tech rather than out of it. Held SPY and IWM, but added a relative time stop to IWM — its rate-relief leg is unconfirmed with TLT flat against a 17% crude collapse, so if it hasn't outperformed SPY from entry by Friday's close I exit regardless of price.

trades.rationale: Closes a structural megacap-tech underweight versus my benchmark on rotation from semis into platforms; invalidation on a close below 708, 2.25:1 asymmetry, 0.44% of bankroll at risk.
